MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 64

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

6. Solve for x: x + 5 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 5
   C. 13
   D. 9

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

11. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 12
   D. 6

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

13. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 10

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 7

18. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 3

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

20. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

21. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

22. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

24. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 7

25. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

26. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

27. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

28. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 17
   D. 73

29. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

30. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
